description: Market assumptions for the CAPM / WACC / DCF valuation engine (app/valuation). Every value has a source and an as-of date; update them before relying on a valuation. Educational project - not investment advice.

INR.risk_free_source: India 10-year government bond yield, approx. 7.20% on 11 Nov 2026 (Trading Economics, India 10Y yield news)
INR.equity_risk_premium_source: Damodaran, Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums, updated 5 Jan 2026: India total ERP 7.08% (mature-market 4.23% + country risk premium 2.85%)
INR.statutory_tax_source: India corporate tax under section 115BAA: 22% + 10% surcharge + 4% cess = 25.17%
INR.terminal_growth_note: Long-run nominal growth assumption for INR cash flows (project assumption, below the INR risk-free rate)

USD.risk_free_source: US 10-year Treasury yield, approx. 4.85% on 9-10 Nov 2026 (Trading Economics / YCharts daily close 6 Nov 2026: 4.86%)
USD.equity_risk_premium_source: Damodaran, Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums, updated 5 Jan 2026: United States total ERP 4.46% (mature-market 4.23% + country risk premium 0.23%)
USD.statutory_tax_source: US federal corporate income tax rate 21% (state taxes excluded)
USD.terminal_growth_note: Long-run nominal growth assumption for USD cash flows (project assumption, below the USD risk-free rate)

beta.method: OLS slope of monthly total-price returns of the stock on the market benchmark
beta.note: Raw (unadjusted) regression beta; the Blume-adjusted beta (0.67 x raw + 0.33) is shown for reference only.

forecast.growth_note: Explicit-period growth = historical revenue CAGR, bounded to [-10%, +15%]; negative history is kept negative. Years 6-10 fade linearly to the terminal growth rate.

cost_of_debt.method: interest expense / average total debt (pre-tax), accepted when between the risk-free rate and risk-free + 10 percentage points; otherwise the debt weight is used with the risk-free rate + 2% and a warning

screening.description: The universe-wide screen uses fixed screening discount rates instead of a computed WACC (no beta for every company). They are disclosed as screening assumptions, not WACC.

valuation_score.note: Composite of available valuation checks. Weights are a documented project choice (equal), not statistically validated; the result is an illustrative composite score, not a validated valuation rating.

scenarios.description: Bear / base / bull are assumption sets around the base DCF, not forecasts or probabilities. Deltas are absolute (0.01 = 1 percentage point); scenario growth stays inside the forecast bounds.
